This patch adds support in the kernel for offloading in the NIC Tx and Rx
checksumming for encapsulated packets (such as VXLAN and IP GRE).

column2: the driver will need to set the right bits

column1: in netdev->hw_enc_features. The protocol driver will have to set the
skb->encapsulation bit and populate the inner headers
use those inner headers to calculate the csum in hardware.

column2: the driver will need to set again the

column1: skb->encapsulation flag and the skb->ip_csum to CHECKSUM_UNNECESSARY.
In that case the protocol driver should push the decapsulated packet up

column2: again with CHECKSUM_UNNECESSARY. In ether case

column1: driver should set the skb->encapsulation flag back to zero. Finally the
protocol driver should have NETIF_F_RXCSUM flag set in its features.
